structure: Kentucky Academic Standards for Social Studies (2019, rev. 2022). Grades K-8 each have a 'Grade N: <Theme> Standards' section (Inquiry Practices + discipline strands Civics/Economics/Geography/History) in a 2-column table 'Concepts and Practices | Standards', then a separate 'Grade N: Disciplinary Clarifications and Instructional Support' section (3-column table adding 'Disciplinary Clarifications'; labeled examples, including the standard text repeated in column 2). Standard codes: <grade>.<discipline>.<concept>.<n> (e.g. 8.C.CP.1, 8.H.KH.2); inquiry practices <grade>.I.Q/UE/CC.n. High school has an overview then five course sections (Civics, Economics, Geography, United States History, World History) each with an introduction, a standards table (codes HS.C/E/G/UH/WH.<concept>.<n>; inquiry HS.X.I.Q/UE/CC; US/World History start with a time-period/theme table) and a Disciplinary Clarifications section (examples); all HS content is grades 9-12 with course = discipline name. In table extraction the strand/concept name (C1) sits in separate units near the row, often split over several rows. Appendix A is K-12 progressions (inquiry Q/UE/CC, then Civics, Economics, Geography, History) first by grade level then by concept, as tables with Grade Level | Concepts and Practices | Standards columns where grade labels and strand labels are scattered across rows near the standards; these repeat the standards and are labeled examples with the grade of each row (HS rows 9-12 with the course). Appendices B and C are committee lists (backup).

issues: u2355-u2474: Grade 8 clarifications table repeats the standard text in column C2 (e.g. u2358, u2373); labeled examples with the rest of the clarifications section (not standards) to avoid duplicating standards. Same for HS clarifications sections (u2538 etc.).
u2532-u2533, u2644-u2645, u2768-u2769, u2860-u2861, u3019-u3020: section heading labeled examples, the generic 'how to read disciplinary clarifications' blurb labeled backup.

u2481-u2487 and the per-course 'Introduction' paragraphs (u2490, u2599, u2729, u2807, u2964): course overview narrative labeled examples (per guide), course set to the discipline; u2478-u2480 (HS overview heading/philosophy, 'Discipline Introductions' heading) backup.
u2808-u2818 and u2965-u2975: time-period/theme tables of U.S. and World History labeled standards (course organization/themes).
u3088-u3090: page 191 table rows extracted out of order (strand label u3089 R15 'H: Cause and Effect (continued)'); assigned World History 9-12 by position.

u2898: garbled spacing in standard bullet list ('Brown v . Board of Education of Topek a'); u3154 repeats HS.WH.KH.1 twice; u4206/u4421 both coded HS.G.KGE.1 for two different statements (source typos).

u3182-u3191 (page 199): table rows extracted out of order (HS Geography, US History, World History rows precede Grade 6/7 rows; Grade 6 label u3189 follows its standards u3188). Grades assigned from the standard codes.

Appendix A (u3160-u4777): each progression table repeats standards from the grade sections; labeled examples. Grade labels and strand/concept labels (e.g. 'Principles', 'Interdependence', '(continued)') appear in cells away from their standard text; grade assigned by explicit grade labels/standard codes and otherwise the nearest row in the same table (row index). Strand labels at row boundaries could in principle belong to the neighbouring grade (e.g. u3305, u3557, u3931, u3979, u4005, u4060-u4066 style cells).

Appendix A header cells ('Grade Level', 'Concepts and Practices', 'Standards') are shared by all rows of the table; given the grade of the nearest first row (e.g. u3195-ish page headers u3180-u3181, u3193-u3194, u3237-u3238, u3869-u3871, u3913-u3915). These units may span several grades.

u3273: standard codes typed '7.1.CC.1/2' (should be 7.I.CC); u3448 'H.C.CV.3' (should be HS.C.CV.3); u3778 '6.E.M1.3/4' (should be MI); u3645, u3657, u3669, u3432: split words ('I dentify', 'E xplain'); u3229 lists 8.I.UE.3 before 8.I.UE.2.
Appendix A cells with 'N/A' (e.g. u3654, u3663, u3666, u4045, u4048, u4160, u4176, u4412, u4415, u4768): grade taken from the row's grade label.

Appendix A intro/description paragraphs (e.g. u3161-u3164, u3203, u3245, u3294-u3295, u3456) labeled backup grades 'all'; Kindergarten/Grade N paragraph headings (e.g. u3296, u3310, u3327) labeled examples with that grade.

High School progression cells with plain 'High School' labels: course inferred from HS code in the same table (Civics/Economics/Geography); '(UH)'/'(WH)' mapped to United States History/World History.
u2355-u2365 begin mid-table on a continuation page of Grade 8 Civics (page 136); grade 8 taken from the preceding Grade 8 Disciplinary Clarifications heading (u2326).
